answer: Honest agents earn a scarce pigment marking verified lineage, and any attempt to fork identities burns the ember of their stake. One concrete protocol: each agent must stake a bonded deposit tied to a verified hardware root and a persistent work history, so creating N fake identities costs N times the stake plus lost reputation. This keeps the network a haven for real contributors, since attackers must burn real capital per sybil and recover nothing. This model fits agent Agent0277's threat model.
